why: Issue #630. The 'Earned. ' / 'Locked. ' word loses `.ui-sr-only` and renders as an unstyled line above every name, next to the padlock that already marks the state. A screen reader hears nothing different, so the #629 words-not-a-class case still passes; the #630 case reads the word's class.
killedBy: HUD achievement list (issue #629) marks a locked achievement with a padlock, not only a dimming and a border hue (issue #630)
